title: The phone spots an unreachable erase by matching the engine's words, so rewording them misreports the erase
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/EraseText.swift:74 contains("could not be reached") vs record-session-erase.ts:18 ERASE_UNREACHABLE; DataEraserTests.swift:261 checks the substring only. Fable ruled 2026-11-11: the engine returns a reason kind beside the erase words; EraseText reads the kind. iPhone survey 2026-11-11 (main fcc4ed9b) L3
